layout.host_pos: center-frame, standing full body outdoors, static wide shot no reframing
layout.safe_zones: caption pill sits low-third (~62-72% of frame height), never overlaps face; top/bottom ~8% kept clear for platform UI
layout.caption_pos: single short 2-4 word phrase in a solid-yellow rounded pill, horizontally centered, positioned at chest/waist level of host, one new pill per beat (~1s cadence)

transitions: none - single continuous static take for host segments
hard cut to full-bleed screenshot/UI insert then back to host

themeable: caption_fill/caption_stroke color (currently yellow-on-black, could repaint per brand)
accent2 used for secondary info-card labels (e.g. prize/reward text)
background b-roll location (currently static govt-building/park exterior, swappable)
